selected_ack_policy: completion bitmap; no optional scan branch
scope: Incremental communication experiments; prior full matrix remains historical.

timing_policy.wall_includes: fixed tensor requests, input clones, Notify, FWD/BWD execution and required synchronization
timing_policy.wall_excludes: one-time reusable buffer and RDMA context initialization
timing_policy.gpu_note: FWD main persistent kernel excludes Notify; BWD total includes its complete kernel.

final_resource_audit.scope: All six unified entry specializations per model. Complete machine/SASS equality to bitmap1 also preserves the previously audited math K loops. This does not relabel bitmap1 GPU timings as final-source timings.

telemetry_limitations: Power >= 300 W is a sample filter, not a kernel-start/end marker.
Samples and per-candidate process intervals include warmup, validation, initialization, and other GPU work.
Sampling is not kernel-aligned; averages are unweighted sample means, not duration-weighted kernel frequencies.
Telemetry establishes observed clocks only; it cannot attribute a timing difference to frequency.

dirty_ack_resource_audit.limitations: No GPU performance or correctness asserted here. Source-compiled offsetof/sizeof assertions preserve wire layout. Large FWD backedges include non-K control; identical MMA regions and local-access counts establish no new static hot-loop spill relative to bitmap0, not that all Forward local accesses are zero.

telemetry_limitations: Power >=300 W is an observation filter, not a kernel marker.
Sampling and process windows are not kernel-aligned; they include preparation, warmup and checks.
A bitmap candidate process interval contains both Forward and Backward work; it cannot isolate either phase's clocks.
Means are unweighted sample means, not duration-weighted kernel frequencies.
An empty selected sample set is reported as empty, with no inferred high-load frequency.

final_runtime_audit.timing_policy: All timing samples retained, including the Qwen 8K large wall sample. No outlier filtering or attribution of its cause.
telemetry_limitations: Power >=300 W is an observation filter, not a kernel marker.
Sampling is not kernel-aligned, and candidate process windows include Forward, Backward, preparation, warmup and checks.
Sample means are unweighted and cannot establish a phase-specific kernel frequency or explain a timing outlier.
